method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Reprint compiled as at 22 August 2003 (amendments to No. 14 of 1996), as deposited at registers/source-bundle/act-1972-46.txt (retrieved 7 September 2026); commencing day not in the deposit, taken as an input

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the young person turning 18: the moment an age is attained (s 4), when full age and full capacity begin, including the s 5(1)(b) transitional limb (s 5(1)), whether one is an adult in law on a given day, how 'full age', 'adult', 'infant', 'minor' and like words in other laws and instruments are read, with the exclusions for ages in years, pre-commencement instruments and wills, non-WA laws and employment instruments (s 5(2), (3), (5), (7)), and incapacities not due to age (s 5(4)). Transitional s 5(6), (8)-(11) and machinery out.
lives: chloe c025 (2021-03-14): turns 18 -- when, in law, do I come of full age, and am I an adult today but not yesterday
